name: Eternal Execution
author: Alex4791
description: Enter to be enthralled in an FPS battle with all of eternity! While the price of it seems too much of a bargain, the enemy count, radar and some special locations in the game all prove vital to navigate your way through the madness and begin eliminating the enemy wave, instead of leaving an FPS fate to the damned. If surviving is the option, we have a plan to execute!
